source: 2015/TSB Vol 15 No 06 - Audi - Ford Coolant Adapters.pdf
title: Coolant Adapters for Audi and Ford Vehicles
lead: MOC has developed 2 new adapters to service the cooling systems in various Audi and Ford vehicles (Part Nos. 94356 and 94357). These adapters are known to fit the 2011-up Ford Fiesta, Focus, Fusion, Escape and Transit. These adapters also fit a variety of Audi vehicles. These adapters connect at the pressurized reserve tank.
body: The photos show the OEM quick disconnects on Ford and Audi vehicles that these adapters connect to.
